title: The 3 programming paradigms that AI cannot replace

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What aspects of programming will remain uniquely human as AI reshapes the field?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI can assist, but low-code tools can't replace the rigor of systems programming or the creativity in functional programming.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If AI handles routine coding, who ensures ethical design in critical systems like medical or military software?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are embedding human oversight in AI-assisted tools, like requiring manual approval for security-critical code.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: We may see a future where AI is a collaborator, not a replacement, in crafting fair and transparent algorithms.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of programming will be a partnership between human insight and AI capability.

video_cue: A diverse team of developers and AI systems working together on a complex software project in a futuristic co-working space.
